reference_execution_policy.commit_rule: Only SW_SOLVE_CONVERGED candidate states become the research trajectory state.
reference_execution_policy.accounting: Every accepted internal substep must expose finite integrated mass residual within 1e-12 cm.
reference_execution_policy.failure_rule: If depth 8 is exhausted, V2 fails. Do not retune the bound inside V2.

rejected retry candidates never become accepted trajectory state
accepted substep count and retry count reported separately for A and B

purpose: Reach the originally preregistered history-collision observation surface while respecting the Reference Richards retry semantics, without changing the physical experiment.
